title: GRIP: Algorithm-Agnostic Machine Unlearning for Mixture-of-Experts via Geometric Router Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2601.16905v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models presents a critical yet under-explored challenge. Current unlearning methods applied to MoE architectures often exploit dynamic routing as an optimization shortcut: rather than genuinely erasing knowledge from expert parameters, they manipulate routers to redirect queries away from the originally assigned experts. This not only causes severe utility degradation but also leaves hazardous knowledge intact. Consequently, adversaries can bypass the router to recover sensitive information directly from dormant experts. In this study, we propose Geometric Routing Invariance Preservation (GRIP), an algorithm-agnostic framework that resolves these failure modes by enforcing hard geometric constraints on router updates. By projecting router gradient updates into the null space of the retain set's routing matrix, GRIP suppresses routing manipulation without freezing the route

translated_title: GRIP：通过几何路由器约束实现混合专家模型算法无关的机器遗忘
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.16905v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：混合专家（MoE）大型语言模型中的机器遗忘是一个关键但尚未充分探索的挑战。当前应用于MoE架构的遗忘方法往往将动态路由作为优化捷径：它们并非真正从专家参数中擦除知识，而是操纵路由器将查询重定向离开原本分配的专家。这不仅导致严重的实用性下降，还使危险知识保持完整。因此，攻击者可以绕过路由器直接从休眠专家中恢复敏感信息。在本研究中，我们提出几何路由不变性保持（GRIP），一种算法无关的框架，通过对路由器更新施加硬几何约束来解决这些失败模式。通过将路由器梯度更新投影到保留集路由矩阵的零空间中，GRIP在不冻结路由的情况下抑制路由操纵。
tldr: 提出GRIP框架，通过几何约束抑制路由器操纵，实现MoE模型中真正有效的机器遗忘，防止知识残留和攻击者绕过风险。
en_tdlr: GRIP framework suppresses router manipulation via geometric constraints, enabling genuine machine unlearning in MoE models while preventing knowledge retention and adversarial bypass.
